change_boundary: Implement one deterministic companion validator for ordered per-commit signed work-order-chain scope. Reuse the existing M9 control plane's canonical signature semantics conceptually; do not create a second scheduler, RTM, release gate or product path. Keep the regression test unchanged.
hypothesis: A small pure deterministic adapter can validate each atomic segment against its own signed work order, enforce parent continuity, exact allowed paths, forbidden patterns and product authorization without modifying the existing M9 scheduler/RTM/release logic.
next_test: Run the unchanged P1 regression on Ubuntu; all six cases must pass. Then run existing M9 literal/control-plane tests to detect accidental duplicate control-plane behavior.
expected_result: Six P1 tests pass; valid two-segment chain is accepted; forged signature, broken parent, unlisted path and unauthorized product path are rejected; no product/controller/workflow/test changes.
rollback_condition: Any regression remains red, valid chain fails, a negative mutation passes, module contains scheduler/RTM/release decisions, or any forbidden path changes.
rollback_command: Discard only the implementation commit by leaving its isolated branch unmerged; do not alter the parent evidence branch or user worktrees.
